# gotion

> gotion is a free desktop app for Windows, macOS and Linux that opens and edits your Notion pages and databases without a browser. It is an independent app built on Notion's public API, not made by or affiliated with Notion Labs, Inc.

## What it does

- Edits Notion pages like Notion: headings, lists, to-dos, quotes, code, @ mentions and the / menu. Only changed blocks are sent back to Notion.
- Databases as tables and cards, with filters and sorts; edit cells, add rows from templates, add and rename columns.
- Works offline: pages you opened stay on your computer, and offline edits are sent when you are back online.
- Tabs and a two-panel split view; comments, images and file uploads.
- Keyboard first: Ctrl+K jumps to any page, Ctrl+N makes a new one.
- English and Bahasa Indonesia.

## Privacy

- The app talks to Notion directly; page content never passes through gotion's server.
- The server only completes Notion's OAuth sign-in and relays change notices (page IDs only).
- gotion can open only the pages the user chose on Notion's consent page, and their subpages.

## Getting started

1. Download the installer for your system from https://gotion.ryanda.my.id/#download (Windows x64/ARM, macOS Apple silicon/Intel, Linux .deb/.rpm/.tar.gz, or `curl -fsSL https://gotion.ryanda.my.id/download/install.sh | sh`).
2. Open gotion and click "Sign in with Notion".
3. Choose which pages gotion may open, then click Allow.
4. Open a page from the sidebar and type.

The installers are not code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen and macOS Gatekeeper warn on first launch.
